status: authored 2026-10-03; generated by tools/arena_dome.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_arena_dome (reapply R9AD, after R9DC). Valid output only: nothing here has been seen in a game
owner_brief: The owner, 2026-10-03: Heaven's Arena "should be a battle zone where a player can go in and always find a cool battle or gauntlet to match up against ... It should be a small tower that becomes a large dome sort of place with several fighting venues inside the main place; each player will have their own progress and their opponent will be spawned in front of them." Site decided: site A of docs/world-building/ARENA_SITE_NORTH.md section 4, the Windward Deep's north floor.
coordinates: challenger_mark, opponent_spot and post are [x, y, z(, yaw)] with x and z at block centres (n + 0.5) and y the FEET y: the block at y-1 is the floor, y and y+1 are air in this build. Yaw is Minecraft's: 0 faces south (+z), 180 faces north (-z).

site.why: ARENA_SITE_NORTH.md section 4, option A: the largest usable disc on the sheer floor, r40 (81 across, 5,025 columns), at least 6 of street left to every Stacks home and 7 to the mouth plaza keep-clear. The model's tread there is y0 and the city writes only paving on it.

limits.why: crown_max: the Compact HQ tower's top is y132 (data/deep_city.json hq) and stays the tallest. crown_must_clear: the pit's lip is y83, and the owner wants the dome to show above it. min_street: the street the measurement found left round option A ("at least 6"); the build refuses if any written column comes nearer than this to anything the city builds, or to any lot's door.

drum.why: A two-block wall (38 < r <= 40) to y70, with two window bands and copper ribs every 15 degrees: the city's own palette (data/deep_city.json materials). y70 is below the lip, so the drum reads from the floor and the dome above it from the Rift.

dome.why: A half-ellipsoid of glass on the drum, semi-axes 40 across and 50 up: outer crown y120, the cupola to y126 (under the HQ's y132), so 43 blocks of it show above the lip. Glass in the Rift's purple between copper meridians and four copper parallels. A chandelier on a chain from the crown over the grand venue.

tower.why: The small tower the owner asked for: a 9-wide gatehouse on the dome's south side, its door facing the apex where the floor route from the lift-bank-3 stair arrives (ARENA_SITE_NORTH.md section 5, route 1). A lobby seven high opens north through a five-wide passage cut in the drum; above the lobby ceiling the tower is solid, its windows lit from behind, so no dark room is left inside it. Top y44, roof lamp to y48.

lighting.why: No minecraft:light (the city's rule). Ochre froglights flush in the floor every 6 blocks, a sea lantern flush at each ring's centre, and a copper post with a lantern at each ring's corners.

entrance.route: On foot from Relay Row (ring 3, y15): down the west lift-bank-3 stair tower to its floor door at (3580, 1, 3241); east to x3593 and north through the 3-wide gap at x3593-3595 z3236-3240 beside the old arena drum (3609, 3249); north across the apex to the tower door at (3584, 1, 3216), 45 blocks of 4-connected walk over y0 floor with nothing at y1-2 (measured 2026-10-03 against the city build and this dome; ARENA_SITE_NORTH.md section 5 had 43 to the wall). From Victory Road's mouth (3560, 1, 3064): south across the mouth plaza and round the dome to the same door, 210 blocks the same way. Not walked in a game.

venues.name: The Gate Ring
venues.why: South-west, the first ring a player passes on the way in from the tower: The Floor, The Shaft and The Relay (data/arena_fights.json ranks 1-3).

venues.name: The Sluice Ring
venues.why: South-east, across the way from the first: The Champion's Door and The Sluice.

venues.name: The Terrace Ring
venues.why: North-east, deeper in: The Terrace and The Tear.

venues.name: The Crown Ring
venues.why: North-west, the last of the four: The Crown.

venues.name: Above the Crown
venues.why: The grand stage under the crown and the chandelier: 19 across, two steps up, the endless streak (rank 9).

venue_why: Four 15x15 rings (13x13 clear floor inside a basalt border, one block up, a copper post and lantern at each corner) on the diagonals, 19 off the centre each way, and the 19x19 grand stage in the middle. The mark is 4 south of a ring's centre and the opponent's spot 4 north, 8 apart, facing each other; the post is 2 east of the mark. Steps up to every ring are on its south side, the side the mark is on. The way in from the tower runs north between the two southern rings (23 wide) to the grand stage's steps. Every ring keeps at least 9 of headroom; the dome's lowest interior ceiling over a ring is far above that.
